The '''''"Starcrusher"''''' was a large [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] made to look like the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It served as a trap for a team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].

==Description==
The vessel was built to superficially look like the ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'', but was completely hollow, with few functioning systems. It carried multiple [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] for emergency situations, had little real life-support and a minimal amount of power to make [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps.

==History==
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent several [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to stage an attack on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Tanker/Legends|fuel tanker]] [[Aurora (fuel tanker)/Legends|''Aurora'']], the decoy arrived to present itself as a target for the infiltrating [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]].

The decoy vessel was successfully infiltrated, but the skeleton crew present fled in escape pods and sent the copy vessel on a crash course with a nearby star.

[[File:Starcrushers_end.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Both ships are destroyed by crashing into a star.]]
In the confusion, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Daan (Human)|Daan]] of the ''Starcrusher''{{'s}} crew was left behind and begrudgingly helped the Jedi come up with an escape plan. The real ''Starcrusher'' entered the system to pick up the skeleton crew. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the battleship in his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] and destroyed its reactor. The dead battleship was then pulled into the decoy vessel, which had become magnetized by the Jedi wiring buttresses aboard the ''"Starcrusher"'' and magnetizing the hull. Both ships fell into the gravity well of the star, destroying them and killing the ''Starcrusher''{{'s}} crew.
